Использовать модель на другом компьютере: Use the model on another computer (remote server)
Трафик между компьютерами не шифруется (: Traffic between the computers is not encrypted (HTTP): the code the model reads and writes and the API key travel in plain text. Enable this only on a trusted home or office network, or over a VPN (Tailscale, WireGuard) or an "ssh -L" tunnel. On the first start Windows will ask for a firewall permission for llama-server — allow access on private networks only.
Этот компьютер раздаёт свою основную мод: This computer shares its main model with other computers running Offload (for example, a low-powered laptop). Auxiliary models (fast, embeddings, rerank) stay available on this computer only.
Основная модель работает на другом компь: The main model runs on another computer — usually a powerful PC with Offload where "Network access" is enabled. This computer then does not start its own main llama.cpp server, and no model download is needed.
